findings.title: Flight step contradicts the new-code boundary
findings.claim: The flight section requires new functions in the guarded tactical sim, while the architecture section says all new code goes outside guarded roots.
findings.evidence: spec L137 requires `stepSoloFlight` in the tactical sim and an export from `contacts.ts`; spec L141 says new code goes in app and render directories and that none of it is under guarded roots; src/renderer/src/sim/tactical/contacts.ts:L38-L45 contains the currently private static-contact pass.
findings.why: The H-1a plan cannot follow both placement rules as written.
findings.fix: Make §10 explicitly allow the two specified tactical-sim changes in §9, while keeping renderer and app code outside guarded roots.

prior.note: Spec L43 sends player 1 away as a replayable tick-0 command on every duel, including restarts at L54.
Spec L100 supplies effective current axes to the model and defines when the runtime records them.
Spec L137 defines a ship-0-only step with static contacts and excludes ship 1 from stepping, collisions and drawing.
Spec L42 uses the duel tick for commands; L53-L56 recreate the driver and duel and reset view and input state.
Spec L45-L51 separates pause reasons and makes focus clear only `blur`.
Spec L143 tests allocation after warm-up and rebuilds the interior view on restart.
Spec L113-L118 defines predictor inputs, steering, horizon, sampling, termination and comparison tests.
Spec L112 puts the lock marker on both consoles; L120 names both hull readouts.
Spec L119 defines counter-based contact sparks and their placement, colour and duration.

verified: The tick-0 presence command in spec L43 is processed before tactical attendance is determined in src/renderer/src/sim/duel/step.ts:L93-L103.
The proposed single-ship step in spec L137 addresses the two-ship behavior in src/renderer/src/sim/tactical/physics.ts:L57-L61 and src/renderer/src/sim/tactical/contacts.ts:L47-L53.
The predictor rules in spec L113-L118 match missile movement and contact order in src/renderer/src/sim/tactical/missiles.ts:L32-L44 and L60-L80.
The warm-up rationale in spec L143 matches first-draw object creation in src/renderer/src/render/roomIcons.ts:L72-L81 and src/renderer/src/render/crewSprites.ts:L55-L71.
not_verified: The run-dir ledger could not be read because filesystem access was denied; the ledger supplied in the request was used.
No tests were run for this read-only spec review.
